status: Read-only source audit. No PAS initialization, firmware copy, authentication, shutdown or GPU mode transition executed.

firmware.provenance: Existing local capture from this phone odm_a /firmware; matches zap-provenance.json

reservation.runtime_requirement: Verify current GCD/HOB reservation and no overlap before a later load. Do not allocate this region from the ordinary EFI pool or map it into bank0/class2/class3.

r131.warning: TSB=0 and CP_MEM_WRITE success are not proof of CP non-secure mode. No PAS or CP_SET_SECURE_MODE was attempted in the r131 host path.

preconditions: same-boot already-verified ARM64 SiP SCM convention
existing owned CX/CFG/AHB and existing transport guards
full raw results retained; unfamiliar transport/WAITQ statuses quarantine; no new exception recovery

availability.result: transport success and full a0=0, availability = !!a1; a1=0 means unavailable only on successful query

supported.result: transport success and full a0=0, supported = !!a1. a1 is boolean result, not the init/auth status code

query_only.effects: No metadata pointer, no firmware or register writes, no PAS state initialization. Target qcom_scm_pas_supported() has no qcom_scm_clk_enable/bw_enable calls.
query_only.limitation: Support/availability do not prove an image has been authenticated, a reserved region is writable, or GPU mode has changed.

later_authenticated_sequence.action: CP_INIT and idle have completed; retain OOB/power; verify stock firmware hash, bounded ELF metadata, reservation ownership, no overlapping allocation and all relevant prior diagnostics. Save a durable checkpoint before mutation.

Metadata buffer only: concatenate 148 header bytes with 3896 hash bytes into 4044 bytes in an owned coherent/NC physical allocation; publish to device/secure firmware. Retain the allocation on any ambiguous return.

later_authenticated_sequence.result: full a0=0 and a1=0; the target Linux wrapper returns transport error or a1

later_authenticated_sequence.action: PAS MEM_SETUP only because this exact ELF has QCOM_MDT_RELOCATABLE

Copy the sole 1072-byte PT_LOAD from file+0x1000 into reservation+0; no file/header/hash bytes outside this segment are GPU microcode. Zero only any source-declared BSS (none in this ELF). Publish stores before AUTH_RESET. Never copy the whole 12088-byte MBN into the 8192-byte reservation.

later_authenticated_sequence.result: full a0=0 and a1=0; stop on error. No CPU accesses to the firmware reservation after the secure firmware may have taken ownership.

later_authenticated_sequence.action: Only after the complete authenticated load succeeded: submit CP_SET_SECURE_MODE opcode0x66 payload0 through the existing ring, wait bounded completion/idle, sample raw TRUST/TSB/faults before and after. Do not substitute a guessed TRUST_CNTL write.
A later known-image test may be qualified only by the actual non-secure transition and A750 graphics-context baseline. Support query or CP writeback alone does not grant this qualification.

retention_and_cleanup.query_only: May return to the normal existing diagnostic-stop path; no newly allocated PAS memory or changed PAS image state.
retention_and_cleanup.after_mutation: Once INIT_IMAGE or MEM_SETUP has been called, nonzero/timeout is not proof that no secure state changed. Keep metadata and the reserved image range retained until the qualified recovery or cold reset; do not clear the range as cleanup.
retention_and_cleanup.after_auth: No direct memset/readback/remap/free of the reserved image as cleanup. Treat it as secure-owned until a source-backed shutdown/reset protocol establishes release.
retention_and_cleanup.pas_shutdown: Target qcom_scm_pas_shutdown is service2 cmd6 arginfo1 PAS13, but the graphics driver unloads on specific hibernation/deepsleep paths. Do not use it automatically as error cleanup or blindly retry it in this experiment.
retention_and_cleanup.timeouts: Existing SCM retry bounds govern returned INTERRUPTED/BUSY states only, not elapsed time inside one SMC. The source does not establish a cancellable hard deadline.
retention_and_cleanup.providers: Target write wrappers enable SCM core/iface/bus and interconnect votes when configured. This phone's captured qcom_scm DT node has no clock/interconnect properties, and those providers are optional in the target driver; this is not measured proof of secure-world loading readiness.

minimal_next_round: Capture raw TRUST/TSB at the qualified idle phases using the independently audited read-only snapshot adapter.

Query call availability for cmd7/1/2/5 and PAS_SUPPORTED(13) via the exact same-boot native ARM64 transport, record full status and elapsed time, then stop. No PAS mutation or mode-exit packet in this query round.
Record the current GCD/HOB reservation covering 0x9b09a000+0x2000 and the held allocation list so the next authenticated loader can avoid overlap.

A subsequent merged authenticated-load + mode-exit + bounded 2D test can follow once these actual results and A750 graphics preamble are qualified; a missing result is a concrete next check, not a permanent blocker.
